lenses.title: Name this landscape
lenses.question: What official names sit in this pack?

items.name: Difficult Run
items.note: GNIS records this as a named stream draining to the Potomac.

items.name: Wolf Trap
items.note: GNIS records Wolf Trap as a named place in Fairfax County.

items.name: Accotink Creek
items.note: GNIS records Accotink Creek as a named tributary to the Potomac.

items.name: Scotts Run
items.note: GNIS records Scotts Run as a named stream in the Potomac gorge.

items.name: Pimmit Run
items.note: GNIS records Pimmit Run as a named stream east of Difficult Run.

items.name: Four Mile Run
items.note: GNIS records Four Mile Run as a named stream to the Potomac.

items.name: Hains Point
items.note: GNIS records Hains Point as the named cape at East Potomac Park.

items.name: Great Falls
items.note: GNIS records Great Falls as the named drop of the Potomac.

lenses.title: Who protects this land
lenses.sourceName: USGS Protected Areas Database of the United States
lenses.question: Who manages the land you can walk?

items.name: Ox Hill Battlefield Park
items.note: County land holds the remaining Fairfax ground of the 1862 fight.

items.name: Scotts Run Nature Preserve
items.note: County land keeps the gorge trail and stream banks open.

items.name: Manassas National Battlefield Park
items.note: Federal land holds the core of First and Second Manassas.

items.name: George Washington Memorial Parkway
items.note: Federal parkway land follows the Potomac shore.

items.name: East Potomac Park
items.note: Federal filled land holds public golf, the loop trail, and cherry plantings.

items.name: Huntley Meadows Park
items.note: County wetland park is a main wildlife record site in the pack.

lenses.title: Wildlife recorded here
lenses.sourceName: EPA Level III Ecoregions and pack wildlife sites
lenses.question: What ecological region is this pack, and what has been recorded?

items.name: Great Blue Heron
items.note: Wetland parks in this pack hold heron records. Huntley Meadows is a usual site.

items.name: White-tailed Deer
items.note: Wooded county parks in the Piedmont hold regular deer records.

items.name: Beaver
items.note: Accotink and other Piedmont streams hold beaver sign.

items.name: Eastern Box Turtle
items.note: Forest floor in Fairfax parks holds box turtle records.

items.name: Red Fox
items.note: Edge habitat around Wolf Trap and county parks holds fox records.
